werewolves.title: The werewolves triumph!
werewolves.line: The village sinks into howling and darkness.

village.title: The village has survived!
village.line: At daybreak, the last wolf has been hunted down.

pied-piper.title: The Pied Piper wins!
pied-piper.line: One last melody — and the whole village dances to his tune.

lovers.title: The lovers win!
lovers.line: United against everyone — to the very end.

angel.title: The Angel is set free!
angel.line: Fallen in the first round — and free at last.

gull.title: The Seagull got everyone!
gull.line: Not a single head stayed clean — shrieking, she circles over the village.

vampire.title: The vampires keep the night!
vampire.line: No heart still beats that does not belong to them.

serial-killer.title: The Serial Killer is the last one left.
serial-killer.line: He wipes the blade clean. There is no one left to watch.

demon.title: The Demon has devoured the village.
demon.line: Whoever reached for him reached into darkness — and stayed there.

stone-golem.title: The Stone Golem is the last one standing.
stone-golem.line: Nothing but dust around him. He does not move — he no longer has to.

werehamster.title: The Werehamster triumphs!
werehamster.line: No wolf howls anymore. Only a soft rustling in the straw.

frida.title: Frida got what she wanted.
frida.line: Eaten at last — and at long, long last no longer shy.

jason.title: This is exactly what Jason wanted.
jason.line: The village lynched him. He is still smiling on the rope.

bella.title: Bella was bitten — her dream came true!
bella.line: Two little wounds on her neck, and it was all worth it.

hermione.title: Hermione saw through everyone!
hermione.line: Every role matched correctly — the village never stood a chance of keeping secrets.

rascal.title: The Rascal won his bet!
rascal.line: Everyone he bet on is six feet under. He cashes in.

groom.title: The Groom takes three brides home!
groom.line: One cycle survived, three rings given — let the wedding begin.

blob.title: The village is one single Blob.
blob.line: Everything alive has been absorbed. Only a gurgling remains.

leech.title: The Leech has drained everyone!
leech.line: Not a drop is left where a village stood a moment ago.

none.title: Nobody survived.
none.line: The village lies deserted in the fog.
